svg.title: VERDICT: Data boundary
svg.text: What data exists, how it is classified, and where each piece is allowed to live.
Anyone can read it, forever. It cannot be erased from the
chain. Only what both sides agreed to make public, with
Lives in the relayer database. Operator access only. Never
put in a transaction, never sent to GenLayer.
Never leaves the relayer. Stored as a hash or in the secrets
vault, never logged, never on-chain, never in a webhook.
the name each side chose; never a full name
submitted by participants, or by the host
juror votes, split, scores, reason, tier history
random idempotency key, carries no identity
free appeal used today, credit left
webhook targets, ref links for K-factor
one per side; proves who may appeal
issued by Twitch to the relayer
Chain boundary: the case packager allow-list.
The digest is computed over the public fields only, so anyone
can recompute it from the chain and match the card.
Nothing is broadcast until both sides tick: “My take becomes
public on GenLayer and can’t be erased from the chain.”
A side can withdraw before FINALIZED. The card is never
published, but anything already broadcast stays on-chain.
VERDICT, Settle It, Live Court, Developer API
